SELECT s.store_id, o.fulfilment_type, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) refund, min(r.return_date), max(r.return_date), count(o.web_order_id) n_match
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.channel_code='WB' OR s.store_id>=900 OR o.web_order_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1,2

WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, fulfilment_type, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
nl AS (
  SELECT w.dd AS bd, w.fulfilment_type ft, f.net_amount AS amt, 'sale' k
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN wd w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net, 'ret_900'
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net, 'ret_store'
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test')
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, k,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ft='click_and_collect' THEN amt END) cc, SUM(amt) tot, count(*) n
FROM nl JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=nl.bd
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,3

FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date

SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) dd, 
 sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cc, sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='home_delivery' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) hd
FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected') AND dispatch_ts_utc BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2025-11-10' AND TIMESTAMP '2025-11-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, fulfilment_type,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, w.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN fact_web_order o  ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN n.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN n.net_sales END) / SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS click_collect_share_pct
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2
